brief:
Israeli occupation forces arrested a Palestinian citizen and served a demolition notice on a residential property in Hebron, Shehab Wire reported. The operation occurred in the southern West Bank city, where such enforcement actions have become routine in recent years. The military has not disclosed the identity of the detainee or clarified the stated justification for the demolition order.

Demolition notices issued by Israeli authorities in Palestinian areas of the West Bank often cite building permit violations, though Palestinians contend such permits are nearly impossible to obtain through official channels. The arrest and demolition notice represent separate enforcement measures that frequently accompany operations in Hebron's most contested neighborhoods.
